description: Free, MIT-licensed animated React components built on Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS 4. Motion primitives, charts, AI agent interface components and composed blocks, installed as source through the shadcn CLI (@beui namespace). Also has a React Native version, beUI Native.
rules: Install components with the shadcn CLI: npx shadcn@latest add @beui/<slug>. The slug list is at https://beui.dev/r.
Components are copied into the project as source, so edit them in place instead of wrapping them.
Components use the motion package (Framer Motion v12) imported from motion/react, and Tailwind CSS 4.
Pass className to any component; it is merged with cn() from @/lib/utils.
Components respect prefers-reduced-motion through useReducedMotion; keep that gate when you change their motion.
User-facing strings can be translated through each component's labels prop or LocaleProvider.
